scope: CPU-only local FFN residual diagnostic; no donor full run, T4, BPB, generation, engine, speed, or rate claim

determinism.minibatch_order: calibration rows in capture order; batch (update-1) mod 16

e68_rank96_anchor.action: no anchor invented; pinned E68 result has no saved rank-96 factor

protocol.fit_score_split: all fits use calibration only; score is the fixed E67/E68 held-out positions

factor.score_factor_conversion: A and Vt cast float64 -> float32 before fp32 donor scoring

router.loss: BCEWithLogits(mean all elements; positive weight E/k)

fit.fit_target: R = y - y_sparse_oracle; router selection does not refit shared

heldout_controls.selection: X arms call Router.select_x_only(normalized_x); no dense z is supplied to it
